title: Random Crashes on Release Builds: Exception Access Violation Read/Exec/Write
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1 stable

### System information

Windows 10/11

### Issue description

Hey. 
I know there are guidelines for reporting issues, but I really can’t provide much information this time. 
I can’t find anything about it online either, and nobody on Reddit was able to help me.

That’s why I’m opening an issue here:

My release build is causing random crashes for some users, where the game simply crashes. 
Sentry is reporting:

- RtlpAllocateNTHeapInternal -Fatal Error: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION_READ / 0x4
 > Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700F, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti

- putc -Fatal Error: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION_EXEC / 0x23770d905e0
 > Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10210U CPU @ 1.60GHz, Intel(R) UHD Graphics

- putc - Fatal Error: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION_EXEC / 0x1c84804b700
 > AMD Ryzen 7 3800XT 8-Core Processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070

- memcpy - Fatal Error: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION_WRITE / 0x0
 > AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor, AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT

My game is running with the compatibility renderer.
I have the savegames from these Errors but I can't reproduce it on my end. Even when I do exactly what the users tell me to do.
But even for my Users it's random 

Even in the godot.log there are no informations about these errors.
I gave them the advice to start the game with following launch options: --rendering-driver d3d12
But there is no feedback yet.

I don’t even know where to start looking for a bug. My game is on the desktop and runs in multiple windows.
It's a game that runs on your taskbar and the UIs are all seperate windows.
The game is 100% written in GDSCript.
What could be causing such errors?
